shots.content_purpose: 以虚焦手持晃动开场，快速推近并 rack focus 落到图1 视线，展示候车亭 MINIMAX 装置与墙面阴影，并让红字随对焦加载
shots.description: The apertures open on a badly defocused, shaking handheld view of the street corner, a warm blurred wash of pale concrete, dark pavement and glass that only surfaces as shapes between shakes, while the camera pushes in at fast speed and the focus racks. The picture resolves onto <Picture 1>: the bus shelter and its white canopy lettering snap into focus with the matching lettering shadow sharpening on the wall behind, the green street sign at the left becomes legible, and the grain and soft highlight bloom of the film look read clearly on the concrete and glass. As the focus locks, the red overlay text at both sides loads in and clears to full opacity. The camera then holds a nearly static shot with only a whisper of handheld drift, and the shelter, pavement and background wall stay otherwise motionless until the end of the shot.

shots.content_purpose: 经扫视转场落到图2 仰拍视线，呈现织物克制飘动与保持可读的 MINIMAX 字样
shots.description: At 00:03.800, the telescopic sweep takes the frame: it whips upward and to the right at fast speed, the street sighting smearing into sideways optical drag with a brief exposure flicker, and the picture switches at peak blur. The frame stabilizes out of the smear and refocuses onto <Picture 2>, the beige facade climbing away in soft grainy daylight with the hanging banner sharpening from top to bottom. The long white fabric flutters in a restrained wind: its lower fold lifts and turns a little, gentle vertical ripples travel down the cloth, the MINIMAX lettering undulates along the fabric surface while staying fully readable, and the red-orange underside flashes into view at the bottom of each lift. The camera holds a nearly static shot with a very slight drift down the facade while the red overlay text loads in and clears, and the flutter continues to the end of the sighting.

shots.content_purpose: 经扫视转场落到图3 屋顶视线，呈现人物如无意捕捉的时尚路人自然走动、转身摆臂
shots.description: At 00:07.400, the next telescopic sweep whips leftward and upward at fast speed, the banner smearing out with optical drag and an exposure flicker, and the picture switches at peak blur; the frame stabilizes and refocuses onto <Picture 3>, the rooftop and the large lettered facade resolving in the same soft low-contrast daylight. The woman turns out of her depicted stance and walks a few natural steps toward the left across the roof as an unposed passerby, shoulders turning first, arms swinging loosely at her sides, the dark-red shoulder bag swaying against her hip and the beige suit fabric shifting with each stride, her gaze passing across the scene instead of into the lens. The camera pans left with small amplitude at slow speed to hold her inside the apertures, the red overlay text loads in and clears as the focus settles, and the parapet, roof surface and lettered facade behind her stay unchanged.

shots.content_purpose: 经扫视转场落到图4 特写，呈现调整镜框与微抬下巴的冷感松弛态度并保持到结尾
shots.description: At 00:11.000, the final telescopic sweep whips rightward and slightly downward at fast speed, the rooftop smearing into optical drag with an exposure flicker, and the picture switches at peak blur; the frame stabilizes and refocuses onto <Picture 4> as the close-up sharpens, the red frame of the sunglasses, the reflected lettering in the mirrored lenses and the fluted facade behind all resolving in soft bloom. The red overlay text loads in with the focus and stays legible through the final frame. One hand rises into the lower edge of the apertures and nudges the glasses frame once at the temple, then withdraws, and the person lifts their chin a few degrees and lets their gaze drift up and to the side with a cool, relaxed expression, holding that fashion-campaign attitude without further movement through the last frame.
